league_audio.name: NFL+ (and NFL+ Premium)
league_audio.what: Live Game Audio included in both tiers: home or away live audio broadcasts for every game this season plus live audio of all nationally broadcast games. Available on phone, tablet, desktop, TV via the NFL app. Teams' 2026 guides (Saints Oct 2026) list NFL+ at $6.99/mo or $49.99/yr; Premium $14.99/mo or $99.99/yr.
league_audio.source: https://www.nfl.com/plus/ (fetched; references 2026 season); pricing from search snippet of https://www.neworleanssaints.com/news/atlanta-falcons-vs-new-orleans-saints-monday-night-football-watch-listen-stream-tv-channel-radio-10-5-2026

league_audio.name: Westwood One national NFL radio (Cumulus)
league_audio.what: 40th consecutive season as national radio partner in 2026: Monday, Sunday and Thursday Night Football, 8 international games, Thanksgiving, Black Friday, Christmas, late-season Saturday games, entire postseason and Super Bowl LXI (Feb 14, 2027). Opened Sep 9, 2026 (Patriots at Seahawks). Free on ~500 affiliate stations; release snippets also cite SiriusXM and Westwood One digital platforms.

league_audio.name: Westwood One Sports app
league_audio.what: Free Cumulus iOS app with live play-by-play, national/local sports talk and podcasts; NFL named, but the listing does not explicitly confirm every NFL game. Older 2022 NFL deal said Westwood One primetime broadcasts stream free on WestwoodOnesports.com, affiliate apps and the NFL App (2022 terms; not re-confirmed for 2026).

league_audio.name: SiriusXM NFL (team broadcasts + SiriusXM NFL Radio ch. 88)
league_audio.what: Sep 2, 2026 release: every NFL game, regular season through Super Bowl, available in vehicles and the SiriusXM app; both home and visiting team broadcasts for every matchup (in-car requires sports play-by-play). SiriusXM NFL Radio is channel 88, 24/7 NFL channel. Per-game channels vary (e.g. Week 4 Cardinals ch. 268 car / 800 app, Giants 199 / 823).
